parsed.summary: The drawing matches every design point the specification states as intended: the CAN controller crystals Y1/Y2 are 16 MHz (the corrected value the spec demands, not 12 MHz), the SM712 TVS arrays D9/D10 sit on the CAN0/CAN1 differential pairs, the LTC4412+P-MOS ideal-diode OR-ing (U6/Q1), the ISL54222 analog switch (U5), the four SN74LVC1G07 e-stop buffers (U15/U22/U35/U36), the WS2812B chain (D5-D7, D18-D21) and the GLOBAL_EN-to-SW1 path are all present and wired as described. The remaining oddities visible on the sheets (USB ideal-diode path not fully working, GLOBAL_EN lacking a sequencing/pull-up so the CM4 may not always boot, LED polarity TODOs, the PoE inverted-power jumper, DNP jumpers and Hirose dummy parts) are exactly the known issues the specification documents, so they are not anomalies. I found no drawing-supported deviation from the intended design.
